CITY OF SOUTH GATE
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING

I  CALL TO ORDER
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY, JULY 12, 2022
  Al Rios, Mayor called a Special City Council meeting to order at 5:01
  p.m.

  ROLL CALL  Yodit Glaze, City Clerk

  PRESENT  Mayor Al Rios, Vice Mayor Maria del Pilar Avalos, Council Member
  Maria Davila, Council Member Denise Diaz, and Council Member Gil
  Hurtado; Interim City Manager Chris Jeffers, City Attorney Raul F.
  Salinas

  ABSENT  City Treasurer Gregory Martinez

  CLOSED SESSION  The Council Members recessed into Closed Session at 5:04 p.m. and
  reconvened at 6:31 p.m. with all Members of Council present. City
  Attorney Salinas reported the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL — PENDING
  LITIGATION

I  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(a),
  54954.9(b)(3)(C)

  a. Eva Valdovinos v. City of South Gate
  b. Raymond Celmer v. City of South Gate (WCAB)

  Item 1(a) is a claim brought against the city from an individual who
  slipped and fell on one of the city's sidewalks. City Attorney's Office
  gave a report and upon completion of that report, on a vote of 5-0, a
  motion made by Mayor Rios and seconded by Council Member Diaz, City
  Council denied that claim.

  Item 1(b) was not discussed in closed session. This item will be brought
  back sometime in the future.

  2.  CONSIDER THE EVALUATION OF PERFORMANCE OF A
  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957(b)(1)

  a. Interim City Manager

I  On item 2(a), the City Attorney gave a presentation and upon completion
  of that presentation there was no reportable action taken.
   SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES OF JULY 12, 2022

  3.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6

  Agency Representation:  Chris Jeffers, Interim City Manager

  Unrepresented Employees: Top Management/Department Directors
  Hourly Employees

  Employee Organizations: SGMEA, SGPMMA, SGDMA, SGPMA,
  SGPOA

  On item 3, City Council received an extended presentation by the Interim
  City Manager with respect to the ongoing labor negotiations. Upon
  completion of that presentation, there was no reportable action taken by
  the City Council, but there was guidance given.

ADJOURNMENT  Council Member Davila unanimously adjourned the meeting at 6:33 p.m.
  and seconded Council Member Hurtado.

PASSED and APPROVED this 27th day of September 2022.

  ATTEST:

Al Rios, Mayor  Yodit  e, City Clerk
